analysis.title: Equity Snap: NVIDIA Corp (NVDA US) - Board takes a U-turn; reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
key_insights: NVIDIA announced effective immediately that Jensen Huang is reinstated as President, CEO and Board member, reversing the 12 Nov CEO transition announcement.
The board voted unanimously to reinstate Huang after a series of discussions with him, and said it is satisfied in his ability to lead NVIDIA.
At the 3QFY27 earnings call on 17 Nov, the Board Chair had categorically stated the board did not intend to reinstate Huang, making this a sharp U-turn within about a week.
The board received input from senior US government officials that gave it confidence his return does not present a national security risk.
President Trump publicly supported Huang's return as CEO (Bloomberg, 16 Nov).
The stock was trading about +28.7% at 9:44 AM ET versus NASDAQ +6.0%, against the 20 Nov priced level of USD125.53.
HSBC rates NVDA Hold with TP USD170.00 and points to its 18 Nov note for valuation and risks.

market_movers.rationale: Huang's reinstatement as CEO removes the leadership uncertainty and the stock is up about 28.7% intraday. HSBC rating stays Hold with TP USD170 per the report header.

earnings_insights: NVIDIA held its 3QFY27 earnings call on 17 Nov, where the Board Chair said the board did not intend to reinstate Huang. No EPS or revenue figures are given in this note.
risk_factors: Governance and leadership credibility risk after the board reversed its stated position within about a week.
Political and national security involvement in a corporate leadership decision.
geopolitical: US government officials gave NVIDIA's board input that Huang's return does not present a national security risk.
President Trump publicly supported Huang's reinstatement as CEO (Bloomberg, 16 Nov).
